title: Living Shield
move_pattern: Starts with Shield Slam. While it has allies, repeats Shield Slam. When all allies are defeated, switches to Smash and repeats it indefinitely (each Smash applies Strength, making it progressively stronger).
notes: Living Shield's behavior is conditional based on ally count. While it has allies fighting alongside it, it uses Shield Slam exclusively. Once all allies are defeated, it switches to Smash, which deals increased damage and applies Strength each turn, becoming increasingly dangerous.
